title: DropBack: refund the price drop, keep the sale
instructions: Voice: a confident, warm product-launch narrator. Pace: brisk but clear, like a polished startup demo video. Short natural pauses at full stops. Slight emphasis on the dollar amounts and on the product name DropBack.

scenes.say: [confident] DropBack, powered by PayPal and Channel3. When the price drops… your customer KEEPS the item, and you keep the sale.
scenes.vo: DropBack, powered by PayPal and Channel3. When the price drops your customer keeps the item, and you keep the sale.

scenes.say: [serious] US shoppers returned $890 billion of goods last year.
scenes.caption: US shoppers returned *$890 billion* of goods last year.

visual.label: *$890 billion* in US retail returns, 2024
visual.source: NRF & Happy Returns, 2024 Consumer Returns report

scenes.vo: US shoppers returned $890 billion of goods last year.

scenes.say: Some returns aren't about the product. A shopper pays $398… then sees it for $298 elsewhere. So they return it, and buy it again.
scenes.caption: Some returns *aren't about the product.* / Pays *$398,* then sees *$298* elsewhere. / So they *return it, and buy it again.*
scenes.vo: Some returns aren't about the product. A shopper pays $398 then sees it for $298 elsewhere. So they return it, and buy it again.

scenes.say: [thoughtful] For the merchant, that return costs about $291: shipping, restocking, markdown, and the lost sale… to avoid a $100 gap.
scenes.caption: For the merchant, that return costs *about $291:* / shipping, restocking, markdown, the lost sale, / to avoid a *$100* gap.
scenes.vo: For the merchant, that return costs about $291: shipping, restocking, markdown, and the lost sale to avoid a $100 gap.

scenes.say: [warmly] DropBack plugs into a merchant's PayPal checkout. Channel3 finds the exact product's live price and history. AI weighs a refund against a return. And the merchant refunds the difference… in ONE click.
scenes.caption: DropBack plugs into a merchant's *PayPal checkout.* / *Channel3:* the exact product's live price and history. *AI* weighs refund vs. return. / The merchant *refunds the difference in one click.*
scenes.vo: DropBack plugs into a merchant's PayPal checkout. Channel3 finds the exact product's live price and history. AI weighs a refund against a return. And the merchant refunds the difference in one click.

scenes.say: [upbeat] Live in PayPal Sandbox: a merchant creates a workspace…
scenes.caption: Live in *PayPal Sandbox:* a merchant creates a workspace…
scenes.vo: Live in PayPal Sandbox: a merchant creates a workspace

scenes.say: …connects their own PayPal account, and paid orders flow in by webhook.
scenes.caption: …connects *their own PayPal account;* paid orders flow in *by webhook.*
scenes.vo: connects their own PayPal account, and paid orders flow in by webhook.

scenes.say: …picks the retailers to price-match, and turns protection on.
scenes.caption: …picks the *retailers to price-match,* and turns *protection on.*
scenes.vo: picks the retailers to price-match, and turns protection on.

scenes.say: A shopper buys Sony headphones: $398, protected for 14 days.
scenes.caption: A shopper buys *Sony headphones:* / *$398,* protected for *14 days.*
scenes.vo: A shopper buys Sony headphones: $398, protected for 14 days.

scenes.say: They pay with PayPal. The order and the capture run through PayPal's Server SDK.
scenes.caption: They pay *with PayPal.* / Order and capture run through *PayPal's Server SDK.*
scenes.vo: They pay with PayPal. The order and the capture run through PayPal's Server SDK.

scenes.say: Day three: they check the live price.
scenes.caption: *Day three:* they check the *live price.*
scenes.vo: Day three: they check the live price.

scenes.say: Channel3 finds the exact model, new and in stock, at a retailer this store matches: $298 at Beach Camera. $100 less.
scenes.caption: *Channel3* finds the exact model, new and in stock: / *$298* at *Beach Camera.* *$100 less.*
scenes.vo: Channel3 finds the exact model, new and in stock, at a retailer this store matches: $298 at Beach Camera. $100 less.

scenes.say: Verified by Channel3, with 46 days of price history. It held steady at $319.99, so this is a real drop.
scenes.caption: *Verified by Channel3:* 46 days of price history. / It held steady at $319.99, so this is a *real drop.*
scenes.vo: Verified by Channel3, with 46 days of price history. It held steady at $319.99, so this is a real drop.

scenes.say: They ask for the difference, instead of a return.
scenes.caption: They ask for *the difference,* instead of a return.
scenes.vo: They ask for the difference, instead of a return.

scenes.say: The merchant sees every request in AG Grid.
scenes.caption: The merchant sees every request in *AG Grid.*
scenes.vo: The merchant sees every request in AG Grid.

scenes.say: The case report shows the Channel3 evidence, a 57 percent return risk, and a return that would cost $291. Refunding $100 saves about $65. [firm] Policy limits are NEVER left to the AI.
scenes.caption: *Channel3 evidence,* a *57%* return risk, a return costing *$291.* / Refunding $100 saves *about $65.* / *Policy limits are never left to the AI.*
scenes.vo: The case report shows the Channel3 evidence, a 57 percent return risk, and a return that would cost $291. Refunding $100 saves about $65. Policy limits are never left to the AI.

scenes.say: One click: PayPal refunds $100, with an idempotency key, so it can never pay twice.
scenes.caption: One click: PayPal refunds *$100,* / with an *idempotency key,* so it can *never pay twice.*
scenes.vo: One click: PayPal refunds $100, with an idempotency key, so it can never pay twice.

scenes.say: [warmly] The buyer keeps the headphones… the merchant keeps the sale.
scenes.caption: The buyer *keeps the headphones;* / the merchant *keeps the sale.*
scenes.vo: The buyer keeps the headphones the merchant keeps the sale.

scenes.say: Built on the APIMatic PayPal Server SDK, with an MCP server for AI agents… and deployed on Render.
scenes.caption: Built on the *APIMatic PayPal Server SDK,* / an *MCP server* for AI agents, *deployed on Render.*
scenes.vo: Built on the APIMatic PayPal Server SDK, with an MCP server for AI agents and deployed on Render.

scenes.say: [confident] Fewer returns. Proof from Channel3. And the money stays on PayPal.

items.title: Fewer *returns*
items.sub: refund the gap, not the box

scenes.vo: Fewer returns. Proof from Channel3. And the money stays on PayPal.

scenes.say: DropBack, by Sartech Labs.
scenes.vo: DropBack, by Sartech Labs.
